select count(*) as subscriptions_started
from fct_subscriptions
where started_date >= date '2026-03-01'
  and started_date < date '2026-04-01'

select plan, count(*) as subscriptions_sold
from fct_subscriptions
group by plan
order by plan

select count(distinct s.user_id) as users_signed_up_may_on_annual_plan
from dim_users u
join fct_subscriptions s on s.user_id = u.user_id
where u.signup_date >= date '2026-05-01'
  and u.signup_date < date '2026-06-01'
  and s.plan = 'annual'
  and s.is_active = true;
select count(*) as habits_ever_created from dim_habits where category = 'fitness'
select count(*) as annual_subscriptions_sold from fct_subscriptions where lower(plan) = 'annual'
